page: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Epdsv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the 64-bit ARM architecture, specifically the Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 128 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 64 KB L1d cache, with hardware-accelerated AES cryptography enabled. The server is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of an 1890 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the E32pds_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core performance and memory efficiency. Multi-core stress-ng CPU tests and Geekbench multi-core scores are rated as strong, supported by a strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation with Clang. Memory subsystem benchmarks reveal top-tier performance, with large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaching 449.0 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 188.31 GB/sec. Passmark database operations and memory scores also rank in the top tier. Conversely, single-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench is average. Large-scale LLM inference presents a clear tradeoff, with prompt processing for a 70B model falling into the poor category at 4.65 tokens/sec, though text generation remains average.

The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is driven by its high memory-to-core ratio and the inclusion of fast local NVMe SSD storage, which reduces the need for external storage attachments for high-throughput workloads. Given its top-tier database operation benchmarks and strong multi-core capabilities, the E32pds_v6 is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, static web serving, software compilation, and data-processing pipelines. It is less optimal for workloads requiring high single-threaded performance or large-scale LLM inference.
description: The Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 32-core Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. It features 256.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per core) and a bundled 1890 GB local NVMe SSD. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance delivers top-tier memory bandwidth and database operation performance, alongside strong multi-core CPU and software compilation capabilities. However, single-core benchmarks and large-scale LLM prompt processing represent performance tradeoffs. With its high memory density and fast local storage, the E32pds_v6 is well-suited for memory-intensive databases, web serving, and multi-threaded data processing.
